title: DEX-Sense Dashboard
tagline: A multi-chain dex dashboard powered by the covalent API to display  blockchain and DEX selectors A DEX token summary A DEX market sentiment and socials summary Details of the asset pairs traded on the DEX
description:
This project utilizes the Covalent API to display:

Both blockchain and DEX selectors
A DEX token summary
A DEX market sentiment and socials summary
Details of the asset pairs traded on the DEX

This project uses react and it's components to connect to the covalent database using the covalent API.  using the covalent template as inspiration i connected using my API KEY to display blockchain and DEX selectors, A DEX token summary, A DEX market sentiment and socials summary, Details of the asset pairs traded on the DEX.

working with covalent api was fun and quite easy to work with.
